description: drain.retry_after_ms binds the replacement dial (WIRE.md §2.9; MCPWARP.md §5.9): a drain with retry_after_ms 5000 while online schedules the replacement dial at least 5000 ms later, plus at most 2000 ms of jitter, so onRetry reports {attempt 0, reason "drain"} with delayMs 5000..7000 (the delay actually waited), never the plain 0-2000 ms drain jitter. Status stays online throughout; the drained connection ends after the replacement's welcome (T38).
